item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00465","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C21","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.84,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a material administrative template for C23's government-wide improvement of statistical work being adapted to Federal scientific research. Both assign a central body continuing responsibility to study a decentralized Federal activity, identify gaps and inefficient use of resources, coordinate improvements involving multiple agencies, consult affected agencies and outside institutions, improve information exchange, and preserve agency-specific operational needs. C21 is closely related in subject and emphasizes coordination of Federal research, but it is a less developed advisory letter rather than a comparably detailed government-wide administrative scheme. C25 concerns scientific activity and contains coordination and dissemination mechanisms, but its primary machinery is a patent-ownership regime.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Foundation shall continue to make comprehensive studies and recommendations regarding the Nation's scientific research effort and its resources for scientific activities, including facilities and scientific personnel, and its foreseeable scientific needs","parent_excerpt":"the Director shall maintain a continuing study for the improvement of the statistical work of the agencies in the executive branch of the Federal Government with a view to obtaining the maximum benefit from the funds and facilities available for such work","explanation":"Both establish a continuing central study of a government-wide technical activity, its needs, and the effective use of available resources."},{"child_excerpt":"to study areas of basic research where gaps or undesirable overlapping of support may exist","parent_excerpt":"including the filling of gaps and overcoming of weaknesses in presently available statistical information","explanation":"The later directive adapts the earlier order's gap-finding objective to basic-research support and adds attention to overlap."},{"child_excerpt":"The Foundation, in concert with each Federal agency concerned, shall review the scientific research programs and activities of the Federal Government ... to formulate methods for strengthening the administration of such programs and activities","parent_excerpt":"The Director, either upon his own initiative or upon the request of any such agency, shall ... make appropriate arrangements for improving statistical work involving relationships between two or more agencies, and ... assist the agencies, by other means, to improve their statistical work.","explanation":"Both use a central coordinating institution working with affected agencies to review and improve administration across agency boundaries."},{"child_excerpt":"The Foundation, in consultation with educational institutions, the heads of Federal agencies ... shall study the effects ... and shall recommend policies and procedures","parent_excerpt":"the Director shall consult Federal agencies whose activities will be substantially affected, and may consult non-Federal groups","explanation":"Both expressly pair consultation with affected Federal agencies and relevant non-Federal bodies when developing government-wide administrative improvements."}]}
